summary: The collaboration API follow-up that shipped as PR #139 and release v0.1.81. After #136 (the M1 cutover) merged on 2026-10-08, Sol's re-verification found F6 and F7, the M1 Sidekick fixed them on a follow-up branch, a re-verify found F8, and #139 went READY waiting on the owner. The owner granted merge authority on 2026-10-09; a pre-existing CI race was rerun rather than waived, #139 merged as c0e46087, v0.1.81 was tagged and the work closed. Facts arrived after the close: the release run's result, then a production observation that the auto-upgraded 0.1.81 CLI could not reach the production Host still running 0.1.63 (manifest v3 versus v2), then the post-restart verification once the owner restarted the Host. Chosen because a real close is followed by facts that matter to it, each causally anchored at the close.

args.text: CI failure disposition: the quota-floor WebSocket test failure is an intermittent, pre-existing race, not #139. Closing a socket with unread data sends a TCP reset that can discard the Close frame. Evidence: the same failure on main at 5b29c0fb (run 37770053382); it passes on four other main heads and on #137; #139 touches no proxy, CLI or quota file. Failed jobs rerun. Not waived: #139 merges only on a green run at its head. The proxy and quota owner decides whether a hard-floor reconnect may reset.
